name: Tiraileur Rodden
original_name: ティライユル・ロデン
source: A blind leader of the "Iru Izore" (Île Isolée) organization, which is based in the Cornwall town. His organization replaces the corrupt army of Fideliterr in protecting people from demons and other hazards. Rodden lost his sight in one of the fights with demons. Moreover, he was presumed dead. But he'll be back in order to contribute to the salvation of mankind.
